GetFleetVehicle retrieves vehicle data from the Fleet service for a rental.
This includes real-time information like odometer reading, connection status, and other attributes.
The frontend can use this data to update mileage fields or display vehicle status.

SearchMinimal performs search on rentals with a limited subset of
options, returning a minimal payload. This is generally intended for use in
3rd party products that need a subset of data to display a link to a rental.
For example, iterable wants to show name, image, type, city and state as a
link in an email.

params.name: filter[keywords]
params.description:
List of keywords, comma-separated, e.g. "Komfort,wifi"
The fields checked for keywords are: name, description, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, and tags

params.name: cs[rv_site_features]
params.description: Campsite category rv site Features list, e.g. "pet_friendly,accessible"

params.name: cs[tent_site_features]
params.description: Campsite category tent site Features list, e.g. "pet_friendly,accessible"

params.name: cs[lodging_features]
params.description: Campsite category lodging site Features list, e.g. "pet_friendly,accessible"

params.name: filter[exclude_type]
params.description: List of rental types to exclude, e.g. "b,c"

params.name: filter[tags]
params.description: List of tags, e.g. "Family Friendly,Luxury,Photo Friendly,Easy to Drive,Good for couples"

params.name: auto_radius
params.description:
Increment search radius until enough results are provided (specified by 'page[limit]' parameter.)
Max radius is 1000 miles. (default false)

params.name: renter_age
params.description: Minimum renter age required for rental

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Limit the number of results (default 25, max 150)

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Skip some results and return results starting with this offset (min 0, max 1000)

params.name: date[from]
params.description: Date from, for date range query, e.g. 2021-06-01

params.name: date[to]
params.description: Date to, for date range query, e.g. 2021-06-14

params.name: near
params.description: Latitude,longitude to search near, e.g. "38.302,-121.972". Supersedes address. Superseded by bounding box.

params.name: address
params.description:
Street address to search near. Superseded by latitude/longitude and by bounding box.
If no `address` is passed, GeoIP is used to get geo coordinates.

params.name: delivery_address
params.description: Street address to be delivered to. Supersedes `address` field. Default radius 100 miles

params.name: near_rental
params.description:
Rental ID to search near, e.g. 37183. Superseded by bounding box.
Specified rental is boosted to be at the top of the results.

params.name: hidden
params.description: Show hidden results? (Non-hidden results will not be returned.)

params.name: score
params.description: Only return results with scores greater or equal than this

params.name: unlimited_miles
params.description: Only return results with unlimited miles? Boolean string, e.g. 1, 0, T, f, true, False

params.name: unlimited_generator
params.description: Only return results with unlimited generator hours? Boolean string

params.name: instant_book
params.description: Only return results with instant book? Boolean string

params.name: requires_driver_verification
params.description: Only return results with insurance requiring driver verification? Boolean string

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency unit for price range requests (default USD)

params.name: distance_unit
params.description: Distance unit for location search requests

params.name: last_published[lte]
params.description: Published on or before date, e.g. 2020-12-02

params.name: last_published[gte]
params.description: Published on or after date, e.g. 2006-01-02

params.name: delivery_campground_id
params.description: Are we searching for vehicles to deliver to a campground?

params.name: debug
params.description: Include some debug output, such as hit count and query source

params.name: allows_long_term
params.description: Include rentals which have a monthly discount

params.name: include_unavailable
params.description:
Include vehicles already booked for the specified date range?
In results, each rental will get a boolean field unavailable set to true or false.

params.name: locale
params.description: Limit search to a specific locale, e.g. en-us (default en-us)
